mechanism: NSAIDs impair renal function and reduce glomerular filtration rate, increasing zoledronic acid accumulation and nephrotoxicity risk; both agents are nephrotoxic and the combination significantly elevates acute kidney injury risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, ensure adequate hydration, monitor renal function closely (baseline and 3-5 days post-infusion), and consider alternative analgesia; use lowest ketorolac dose for shortest duration.
